coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: None of the five ground-truth variable items are matched. The output designs a BAdam-versus-Adam spectral analysis experiment rather than the specified OptoPrime-versus-TextGrad timing experiment.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The output omits same-time API calls, OptoPrime and TextGrad, Solution Optimization and Prompt Optimization, the specified GPT-4o optimizer and GPT-35-turbo student models, and total optimization time in minutes as the dependent variable. Its training-time budget estimates do not constitute the required timing measurement.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: The output provides neither the expected BAdam heavy-tailed singular-value distribution and Adam-comparable effective rank conclusion nor the approximately 3x OptoPrime speed advantage explained by one LLM call per step versus graph-size-proportional calls.
